text_5aaa70a46011: Untravelled routes are black. When the last matched journey was up to 180 days ago, blue means fewer than two journeys per direction and green means at least two in each direction. Sections turn orange from day 181 and red from day 366. Orange and red take priority over blue and green. Each section uses the most recent journey date from your GPS recordings, regardless of direction. The app counts calendar days in Europe/Berlin. Loading or viewing the map never resets the journey date; travelling the section again updates it.
text_57cc4a68827f: If an older view has no journey date, the GPS track stays blue and is not treated as freshly green. Update the server too and choose Load routes to retrieve the stored GPS timestamps. Original GPS data remain unchanged.
text_24bb17956723: Untravelled routes black; last journey over 180 days orange and over 365 days red. Journey dates from GPS timestamps; blue/green still apply up to 180 days.
